description: Turns a set of lab values, for example from a type 2 diabetes, kidney, lupus or cancer-survivor check-up, into guideline-cited suggestions and questions for the care team (ADA, KDIGO, EULAR/ACR, NCCN). Made-up or de-identified values only. For research/education with SYNTHETIC or de-identified data only. Do NOT submit protected health information (PHI). Inputs are not stored, except that a claim link, when offered, holds the submitted values for up to 30 minutes so the person can add them to their own account; unclaimed values are then deleted.

age.description: Age in years of the synthetic persona (improves reference-range interpretation).

biologicalSex.description: Biological sex of the synthetic persona (sex-specific reference ranges).

biomarkers.description: Map of biomarker name -> numeric value, e.g. { "Hemoglobin A1c": 5.4 }. SYNTHETIC ONLY.

include_partner_options.description: If true, include partner/product options. Default false.
